scope: Normal development and artificial diagnostics only
teacher: verified ImageNet V1 ResNet18 raw layer2/layer3; all parameters and BatchNorm frozen
student: Conv3x3 stride2 pad1: 3->16->32->64, ReLU each; head1 Conv1x1 64->128; high Conv3x3 stride2 pad1 64->96 ReLU; head2 Conv1x1 96->256; all biases; no BatchNorm/dropout
input: RGB128 full-frame bilinear antialias /255; ImageNet channel mean/std both networks
normalization: per spatial vector channel L2 eps1e-6 both features; no fitted statistics
loss: channel-summed squared unit-vector difference per level; bilinear high map to16x16 align_corners=false; equal level mean; mean batch/spatial
map: bilinear raw discrepancy to128x128 align_corners=false; no smoothing/pixel threshold
checkpoint: strict minimum normal validation loss, ties earlier; calibration inaccessible to selection
training_shuffle: seeded Torch generator 42; exact full membership each epoch
calibration: normal calibration only float64 linear q95 strict greater-than
synthetic: same fixed first16 validation checkerboards as2C; diagnostic only, never used for selection
timing: first validation image and first8 validation images;5warmups30repeats preloaded;30 warm-cache decodes
smoke: first16 train and first8 validation, one epoch two updates; fresh model/optimizer for full run
deviation_from_2c_proposal: owner requested compact convolutional student and max12 epochs, replacing planning-only matching ResNet18/20epochs; prior proposal preserved
